analysis_settings.weighting: equal regime weights; paired resampling within regime
analysis_settings.interpretation: Development-only descriptive uncertainty; no significance gate or fresh-validation claim.
analysis_settings.selection: minimum mean error among valid completed native seed/descendants; earlier generation then source SHA on ties
decision_examples: first completed response in each case
first completed response decided at or after query50000 in each case
analysis_settings.decision_recovery_rule: nearest actual recorded trace at or after requested offset from decision; never cross next environment boundary
analysis_settings.episode_selection: post hoc lowest and highest selected-minus-heuristic completed-environment mean error, excluding initial environment; ties by earlier environment then case index

limitations: All eight cases were used for native development and selection; no fresh validation.
Retained particle follows ordinary PSO; all five memories are reevaluated and retain velocity.
Decision features are sequentially observed refreshed memories; no hidden freshness oracle.
Behavior and post hoc episodes do not identify a causal mediator.
